items.title: GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. (GEHC) Beats Q2 Expectations, Reaffirms 2026 Outlook Despite CFO Transition
items.summary: GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. (NASDAQ:GEHC) posted preliminary fiscal second-quarter 2026 financial results on July 23, reporting accelerated top-line growth and earnings that topped management’s prior expectations. The announcement was paired with news that Chief Financial Officer James (Jay) Saccaro will step down on August 14 to take an expanded role outside the medical technology industry. […]

items.title: Can GE HealthCare Sustain Growth in Q2 Amid Persistent Cost Headwinds?
items.summary: GE HealthCare heads into Q2 earnings season with solid revenue drivers, but inflation and tariff costs may keep margins under pressure before an expected second-half recovery.

items.title: GE Aerospace Faces a Prove-It Moment in Q2 Earnings

items.title: GEHC Stock Up on $500M Strategic Care Alliance With Catholic Health

items.title: GE HealthCare (GEHC) Lands $500 Million Catholic Health Deal For Imaging And AI
items.summary: GE HealthCare Technologies and Catholic Health have entered a roughly $500m Care Alliance spanning 10 years. The agreement covers modernization of imaging, cardiology, and other specialty services across more than 40 Catholic Health sites. The partnership includes advanced imaging systems, AI-enabled tools, software, cloud solutions, and asset management services.
